author: Enivicivokke
quote: An absolute disappointment. If you’re going to create a visual spectacle, you have to back it up with the gameplay. This game lacks the one essential element that defines GTA: "freedom." It makes no sense to be forced to do things here that I wouldn't even want to do in real life. In my opinion, it should have been called "The Sims: Vice City." You could even argue that *The Sims* offers more freedom than *GTA 6*. Unfortunately, it’s $80 completely wasted. Magnificent graphics-which you can’t even fully enjoy due to inadequate hardware (PS5)-paired with a terrible story and abysmal gameplay.
